questions.stem: Which of the following correctly describes the order of events in a homeostatic control system?

options.text: Effector, receptor, coordination centre, stimulus, response
Stimulus, receptor, coordination centre, effector, response
Receptor, stimulus, effector, coordination centre, response
Coordination centre, receptor, stimulus, effector, response

questions.explanation: The correct sequence is: a stimulus causes a change, receptors detect it, the coordination centre processes the information, effectors carry out the response to restore conditions.
